_readme: Which shelf candidates belong to one series, written by tools/series.py from agents following tools/series-prompt.md. The reader reads a series whole (2026-10-25), so the viewer and /book-suggest propose a `series` as ONE entry; a `universe` (shared world, standalone novels) is not grouped. book-cache.json `series` is only the raw catalogue value and is often a publisher's line. /book-screen adds a new volume here; /book-log moves a logged volume from `members` to `read`.
